completion_audit_ref.coverage_explanation: The document captures 10 of the 11 catalogued rules (QF01-QF05, QF07-QF11) as well as the lifecycle boundaries, retry instruction, correlation ID, and mockup contents. However, rule QF06 regarding provider exclusivity and the explicit exclusion of MarketPulse and CustodyBridge is missing, and Section 5.1 introduces unsupported prerequisite duties.

findings.explanation: The text reframes system behavioral rules into client implementation duties, deployment prerequisites, and downstream system obligations ('Client organizations and integrating teams must implement policies', 'Client onboarding workflows must capture...', 'Downstream systems must respect...'). Additionally, stating 'Questionnaires must be maintained on version Q3' incorrectly treats Q3 as an exclusive prerequisite, whereas the source evidence establishes that Q2 drafts remain valid and submittable until 2026-09-01.

Source rule QF06 is entirely omitted: the source specifies that RiskSignal is the only external business provider called by risk profiling, and that MarketPulse and CustodyBridge are unrelated to profile submission.
